description: INVOKE (OO method call), ISO §2023:14.9.23 — introduced 2002. LIVE since the Phase-3 spine part 2 (DEVLOG 601): Class NEW RETURNING → new C(); no-arg instance INVOKE → virtual call behind the EC-OO-NULL guard (§2023:14.9.23.4 GR5); USING/RETURNING marshaling (slice 2), SELF/SUPER (3b), factory and universal dispatch stage loud. Below 2002 the VersionConformancePass parse arm names the edition on RECOGNITION (VisitInvokeStatement -> 0900) — invokeStatement carries no version predicate, so an INVOKE whose target does not resolve names its edition too (kb/Work PB353).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. IV.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS IVC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 OBJ USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE IVC.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INVOKE IVC "NEW" RETURNING OBJ.
    INVOKE OBJ "DOIT".
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM IV.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. IVC INHERITS FROM BASE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS BASE.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
METHOD-ID. DOIT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DISPLAY "OK".
END METHOD DOIT.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS IVC.
